name: Kleos
steps: Bridge HYPE to Elysium with the in-app Bridge. The Fast bridge, "through Relay, moves HYPE and tokens between Elysium and HyperEVM or other chains in seconds, for Relay's fee plus 0.5%." Keep some HYPE for gas.
Trade coins on Kleos. Your daily points follow the HYPE you buy and sell, and coins launched on Kleos count double.

Join a clan, or create one, on the Clans page. "Creating, joining and leaving are a signed message from your wallet, not a transaction." A clan holds 25 wallets, and once you join, "You can leave whenever you like, but you can only join another clan after that." 7 days later. Most top clans are already full.
After your first trade, check in each day on the Rewards page. "Free: you sign a message, no transaction."
Optional: from 15 November, prove your Hyperliquid HYPE stake with the passport on the Portfolio page for the boost. It takes one HyperEVM transaction.
what: Kleos splits 30M KLEOS, 3% of supply, among the top 15 trading clans on Elysium. Points come from paid trading, with no end date and an anonymous team.
behind: Kleos names no one. The only contact on the site is a developer email, [email protected] , for builders. We found no legal entity, no funding announcement from Kleos and no raise reported by a named news outlet. Odaily covered Kleos on 9 November 2026 as one of the launchpads on Elysium, noting that it "does not have a separate Bonding Curve phase." The KLEOS staking contract, Kleos says, has
costs: Kleos is not free to farm. Points come from trading volume, LP fees or launching coins people trade, and every trade costs money: Classic coins "pay their pool's 1% fee on every trade." Taxed coins "charge their creator's buy and sell tax", which the app caps at 10% each way. Limit orders cost 0.5% "of the order's HYPE when it fills, and nothing if it doesn't." Gas is paid in HYPE, and the Fast br
risks: The team is anonymous. We found no named people, company, terms of service, privacy policy or audit on the site. No excluded countries, age limit or KYC are published. Joining is by wallet signature only. Clan Wars has no published end date or payout date. Only 15 of the 43 clans on the board will get anything. Rules changed during the season: new weights were added on 7, 13 and 15 November. Anyon

name: Melee
steps: Check the barred list further down. Melee's app may load even where its terms bar you.
Go to melee.markets and press Enter beta.
Log in. The app offers "Continue with email or social", Google or a Solana wallet, and says: "No crypto wallet needed. We'll set one up for you."

Add a code if you have one, through its link or Claim a code on your profile. The site says "Access drops in waves", with "Codes released regularly on Twitter and Discord." We saw none in Melee's X posts from 26 to 31 October, and we couldn't test whether a code is still required.
Set a username and take the tutorial. The welcome case "Opens once your profile and the tutorial are done."
Open the daily case and trade each day to keep a streak. If you want to create markets, apply through the form in Melee's Phase 3 post.
what: No Melee airdrop is confirmed. The free Solana beta uses test money, and your rank sets a Score multiplier on mainnet. How to join, who is barred, risks.
behind: The terms name "Melee Markets Inc.", while the site footer says "Melee Inc." No address is given, and the terms use Cayman Islands law. There is no team page. On X, the user maximilian (@itsmaximilian) describes himself as "ceo @meleemarkets". Melee says only that it is "built by a team of blockchain, trading and big tech veterans". On 24 September 2025 Melee announced: "Melee has raised $3.5 Mill
costs: The beta is free. Melee calls it "A free ranked season on live markets", and tUSD is claimed daily with no deposit. Trades in the app carry a fee in test money, and gas isn't mentioned. Fees at mainnet are unknown. There is no fee schedule, and the terms warn that "the precise fee applicable to a particular transaction may not be disclosed in advance". A 2% creator cut appears only in a mock-up on
risks: Barred: the terms exclude residents and citizens of the United States, the Crimea region, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria and Russia, plus sanctioned places and anywhere crypto is prohibited or restricted. They add: "THERE ARE NO EXCEPTIONS." Age and VPNs: "These Services are offered and available to users who are 18 years of age or older." The terms also ban using a VPN to get around the restricti

name: Monolith
steps: Open swanusd.com/airdrop from a link you typed yourself and enter your Ethereum address in the checker. If it is not listed, it cannot qualify for the launch pool.
Stake a little over 1,000 swanUSD to get at least 1,000 sSwanUSD.
Optionally deposit the sSwanUSD in SWAN-rewards staking. It still counts for the airdrop and also earns SWAN emissions.
Keep at least 1,000 sSwanUSD for 7 full days. Start no later than 12 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Watch @MonolithMarket for the claim date, then claim before the expiry. Monolith says it never sends DMs first, so ignore anyone who messages you with a claim link.
what: Monolith's swanUSD shares 100,000 SWAN among snapshot-listed addresses that hold 1,000 sSwanUSD for 7 days by 19 November. Newcomers cannot qualify.
behind: Monolith is built and owned by Inverse Finance DAO, the group behind the DOLA stablecoin and FiRM. The code's author is Nour Haridy, who introduced it on X on 6 March 2025: "Excited to finally unveil Monolith, a permissionless stablecoin deployment platform". The launch was paid for by Inverse itself; a forum proposal that month asked to "Approve 332,052 DOLA to Product Working Group multisig". We
costs: There is no entry fee, but you need about $1,000 or more in sSwanUSD locked up for at least 7 days, and every step pays Ethereum mainnet gas: minting or swapping, staking, depositing and claiming. If you mint, paid debt carries a variable interest rate and free debt is 0% but can be redeemed against your collateral. Liquidations carry a penalty of up to 10%. Monolith has not published swanUSD's mi
risks: The airdrop is closed to newcomers. Only the 12,078 addresses on the 19 October 2026 snapshot can qualify, and there is no appeal. No terms of service, legal entity, excluded countries, age rule or KYC policy are published for Monolith or swanUSD. The airdrop has campaign terms only. Monolith's risk page says: "Only deploy capital you are prepared to lose." The app adds: "This is an experimental p

name: Axis Robotics
steps: Sign up at Axis Hub with email, Google, X or a wallet. Tasks are back since Season 2 started on 23 October. It runs in a desktop browser without a GPU.
Pick a pre-training task and finish it with the mouse or keyboard. Failed attempts aren't uploaded.
Try post-training tasks, where you take over when a trained policy slips. A run that uses up its 30-second takeover budget scores nothing.
Open Portfolio, go to History and press Sign on each run before the Friday cut-off. Warning Only runs signed on Base count. A run you don't sign before the cut-off doesn't count.
Check the Alliance tab for partner tasks, such as BitRobot's, that pay a partner reward on top of points.

If you contributed in Season 1, check your allocation at airdrop.axisrobotics.ai with your Axis Hub account or Sonar wallet, then claim it on Base. Warning The claim page says "airdrop.axisrobotics.ai is the only official site. Axis will never ask for your seed phrase or private key."
what: $AXIS launched on 21 October 2026 and the Season 1 airdrop claim is open. Season 2 started on 23 October with a 60M AXIS pool. How to earn points and risks.
behind: Axis announced a $12 million seed round in July 2026, led by Hack VC with Nomad Capital, Pi Network Ventures and 10K Ventures. The copyright line on its website names Anima Technology Pte. Ltd., and the claim site's legal page names Axis Robotics Limited, incorporated in the British Virgin Islands, as the publisher of the sale documents. Get the next airdrop first We post new guides, claim opening
costs: Taking part is free. Signing costs Base gas, which the docs put at "a tiny fraction of a cent", and Axis covers it during gasless campaigns. The claim page says "Checking eligibility requires no signature and no fee"; the claim itself is a transaction on Base.
risks: Points can't be transferred or cashed out, and Axis hasn't published how Season 2 points turn into AXIS. Axis hasn't published a closing date for the Season 1 claim. Automated checks drop random, spammy and duplicate runs. The token sale excluded US persons and residents and citizens of 26 other jurisdictions, including the UK and mainland China.

name: Coinzilla
steps: Check that you can win. The contest is "open to individuals aged 18 or older, with a valid email address", and residents of about 80 countries are excluded (the list is below).
Open play.coinzilla.com and press Enter. Move with the arrow keys or A and D, and pause with the space bar. On a phone, the game asks you to turn it sideways.
Play a game past 30 points, then sign in with your email address and the code it sends. Use an inbox you read, because that is how winners are told.
Keep playing until 18 November at 23:59 EET. Only your best saved game counts, and "Each person may take part with one account only."
what: No Coinzilla airdrop. Its free BUGGED arcade game gives GTA VI keys to the top 10 scores and a PS5 voucher to 1st place until 18 November. Steps and rules.
behind: The game and the contest are run by Sevio Digital Limited, the company behind Coinzilla, described in the rules as "a private company limited by shares registered in Ireland", registration number 729804, at 20 Harcourt Street, Dublin 2. The blog dates Coinzilla's start to 9 November 2016, and Coinzilla says "Crypto Expo Europe named Coinzilla the Best Crypto Traffic Network for 2026". Its X accoun
costs: Entry costs nothing: "Participation is free. No purchase or payment of any kind is necessary." You can even play without an account; you only need one to save a score. Coinzilla says of your email address: "We do not send marketing email and do not sell or share your address." Prizes come as vouchers and digital keys by email, and "Prizes cannot be exchanged for cash or other goods". The organizer
risks: Age: 18 or older. Employees and contractors of the organizer and its group, and their families, can play but can't win. Excluded countries, as the rules list them: Afghanistan, Algeria, Angola, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bahrain, Belarus, Benin, Botswana, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cambodia, Cameroon, Cape Verde, Central African Republic, Chad, Comoros, Cote d'Ivoire, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Djibo

name: Cycles
steps: Install Cycles Pay from the App Store or Google Play . You can also use the web app at pay.cycles.money , but the phone app holds your keys and signs for it. Warning The keys live on your phone, and Cycles can't restore them. The terms say: "IF YOU LOSE YOUR PRIVATE KEYS, YOUR FUNDS WILL BE PERMANENTLY INACCESSIBLE."
Sign up with an email code, Google or Apple, and choose a personal account. You don't need an invite code. A referral code is optional.
Skip identity checks unless you want bank transfers. Those go through banking partners that ask for KYC.

Fund the account with stablecoins from a wallet or an exchange. Warning This is real money in a beta app. The terms say: "THERE IS NO INSURANCE (SUCH AS FDIC COVERAGE), AND RETURNS ARE NOT GUARANTEED."
Use the app. Send a payment, create or pay an invoice, split an expense, or move part of your balance into a vault.
Open Points in the app to see the missions, the claims and your total.

If you used Cycles Pay before 16 September 2026, follow the in-app move from Neutron to Arc. Warning Cycles says its Neutron contracts stay active only until 1 November 2026. It also reported on 22 September that Neutron had halted, so move old balances as soon as the app lets you.
what: Cycles has no token and says it won't rush one. How Cycles Pay points are earned in its stablecoin payments app, what it costs and the risks.
behind: Cycles Protocol SA is registered in Lausanne, Switzerland. Ethan Buchman, co-founder of Cosmos and of Informal Systems, is its founder and chief executive. Cycles says it has raised $8.7 million: a $6.4 million seed round in May 2026 led by Blockchange Ventures, with Coinbase Ventures, Compound VC and Primitive Ventures, after a $2.3 million pre-seed in 2025. The terms state that Cycles "is not a
costs: The app is free, and Cycles advertises "No fees". It publishes no fee schedule. The terms reserve the right to charge a network access fee and other fees, and say beta pricing can end at any time. Bank transfers run through outside providers with their own charges. Signing up costs nothing, and feedback can earn points without a deposit. Most missions need real stablecoins in the app.
risks: Points can't be transferred or sold. Cycles can change or cancel them at any time, and they are forfeited if the program ends. Vault returns vary. The terms list smart contract failure, depegging and loss of principal among the risks, and say Cycles isn't responsible for the outside protocols. The two published audits cover the earlier system on Neutron, and one of them was done by Informal System

name: Perle
steps: Open app.perle.xyz and sign in with Google, an email code or a Solana wallet such as Phantom, Solflare or Backpack. The sign-up asks for no ID.
If you signed in with Google or email, link a Solana wallet in Settings. Keep a little SOL in it: the app checks for at least 0.001 SOL before it records an answer on Solana.
Open the Marketplace and do the Educational projects first. They are the qualification step that unlocks the other projects.
Check your points on the Dashboard and under Earnings.
If you took the six-month lock in March, claim your PRL at claim.perle.xyz before 21 March 2027.
what: Perle's PRL airdrop for early contributors is closed. Season 2 points have no stated payoff. How the AI data tasks work, what they cost and the risks.
behind: Perle, Inc. runs the platform. Its founder and chief executive, Ahmed Rashad, studied at MIT, worked at Amazon and was an early head of operations at Scale AI, according to Perle's team page. The company says it has raised $17.5 million: $8.5 million in October 2024 led by CoinFund, and a $9 million seed round led by Framework Ventures in August 2025. Halborn reviewed the PRL token in March 2026 a
costs: Perle asks for no fee, deposit or purchase. The only cost is Solana network fees, and the app wants at least 0.001 SOL in your wallet to submit an answer and 0.01 SOL to claim a badge. The work is paid in points only.
risks: No written terms cover the points program. The terms on Perle's site don't mention points, rewards or tokens. The March airdrop excluded US persons and people in Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Crimea, Donetsk and Luhansk, and its claim page blocked VPN users. Claiming that airdrop required a palm scan with VeryAI, done with a phone camera. Some tasks record your voice. The site terms give Perle a licenc

name: Pursuit
steps: Open beta.pursuit.games , which pursuit.games links to, and join the waitlist with your email. You can add your X handle.
Share your friend link if you want to move up the line. "Codes go out in waves."
Wait for your code by email, or reply to Pursuit's 5 November post on X , which invites people to ask for a code there. Some codes are also posted by @pursuitsportsgg.
Sign in with a passkey, a wallet, X or email, pick a manager name and enter your code. A wallet is created for you.
what: No Pursuit airdrop or token is announced. Its fantasy football card game is in an invite-only beta on Monad testnet, played with fake money. How to get in.
behind: The launch post names two founders by X handle only. It says @adotjdott "was one of Sorare's earliest & largest users before spending 4+ years backing sports and crypto at Sfermion", and "@techld1 previously led tech at Sfermion, following roles in research at Facebook, decision science at Carvana, and quant at Koch." No company is named on Pursuit's pages. A beta page says the team is raising
costs: The waitlist and the beta are free, and the beta needs no deposit or gas. At mainnet, packs will be sold. The launch post says: "Rip packs, build your lineup, and compete in weekly contests for prizes." Pack prices aren't published. In the beta, packs are "priced live by real demand", so each pack bought raises the price of the next. On the card marketplace, sellers pay a 3% royalty and buyers pay
risks: No terms of service, privacy policy or company name is published, and pursuit.games/terms returns an error page. Prize rules, eligible countries and age limits aren't written down anywhere we found. The waitlist collects your email and, if you add it, your X handle, with no privacy policy saying how they are used. Nothing is promised. Beta Coins, cards and prizes have no stated value, and the test

name: Daejin
steps: Open daejin.xyz/loyalty , the Jin Points page. The address daejin.xyz/points from Daejin's post of 17 November returned an error when we tried it on 20 November 2026.
Unlock your points. The Season 0 post puts it as "Register and link X or Discord to unlock your Jin Points". Locked points do not count at a snapshot.
Do the free tasks each day: the daily check-in, then "Take a side in Market of the Day, or take your free pick".
Optional: once you reach a badge, make a Jin Pass card from your profile and post it on X for the 24-hour boost.
Check your rank before each Thursday snapshot at 00:00 UTC.
what: Daejin has no token or airdrop. Jin Points Season 0 ranks players for a 50,000 DOGE pool. Free picks, real-money trading, no US or Korea. Steps and risks.
behind: Nobody is named. The site footer says "Operated by BytePlay Ltd." and the terms identify it as "BytePlay Ltd., a company incorporated in Belize (IBC No. 000049527)". Its contact is a ProtonMail address. We found no founder, team page, investor or funding round, and the price and owners behind the TokenPlay AI deal are not disclosed. The site footer shows an Alibaba Cloud logo under "CLOUD AND AI I
costs: Joining Jin Points is free, and the check-in, the free pick and the social tasks cost nothing. Trading is where money comes in. Markets on the live chains use real USDC, and you pay the network gas. The terms say there is "no fee on principal, deposits, or losing positions." Daejin takes 2% of the profit, "deducted when you close or redeem a profitable position". Creating a market costs, in the te
risks: Two countries are shut out by name: "DAEJIN is not available to persons in the United States or South Korea". Sanctioned jurisdictions are excluded too, without a list. Age: "You must be at least 18 years old, or the age of majority in your jurisdiction if higher". No VPN: "You must not use a VPN, proxy, false information, or any other means to conceal your location or identity". There is no KYC t

name: Flint
steps: Trade perps on Flint devnet. Open long or short positions, manage them and close them. Your rank is your P&L on the 10,000 test USDC.
Send /register to the bot to get your registration link. The form asks for your X handle and a "Confirmation that you follow @Flint_Trade_ on X", and you accept the rules, terms and privacy notice.

Send product feedback or a bug report from the trading screen. Without it you get nothing: the rules require a "Completed registration form and product feedback or bug report(s) submitted before the End".
Finish both before 20 November 2026 at 11:00 UTC. Flint contacts winners on Telegram for a Solana wallet address. "If you do not give one within 14 days, you forfeit the prize."
what: Flint runs a free perps trading contest on Solana devnet until 20 Nov: 10,000 USDC for 21 traders, plus Flint Points. No token or airdrop is promised.
behind: The homepage names the founders: Joshua Watts, co-founder and chief executive, formerly at the dYdX Foundation, and David Gorski, co-founder and chief technology officer, formerly at Jito Labs and Jump Trading. Six more team members are listed with LinkedIn profiles. "Flint Operations Inc., a Panama company", runs the contest, under licence from Flint Foundation, "an exempted limited guarantee fou
costs: The contest is free. The rules say: "NO PURCHASE OR DEPOSIT NEEDED. DEVNET TEST TOKENS HAVE NO VALUE. NOT OPEN TO RESTRICTED PERSONS." The test USDC "has no value and cannot be withdrawn, sold or carried over to Mainnet." Money only comes in later. Points count toward the invite-only Mainnet Closed Alpha, and that is different: "The Closed Alpha uses real assets that you can lose." Flint also warn
risks: You must "be 18 or older, or the age of majority where you live if higher;" Restricted countries in the terms: "the United States (including its territories and possessions), Canada, the United Kingdom, Panama, Iran, Cuba, North Korea, Syria, Sudan, South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Yemen, Somalia, Libya, and the Crimea", the Donetsk and Luhansk regions, the occupied parts of Zapo

name: MMIX
needs: Requires: Telegram, X post, Email, Discord
steps: Do the one-time tasks: follow on X, join Discord, join Telegram.
Before 23 November 2026, 21:00 UTC, like, repost and comment on the 17 November announcement for the 200 points.
Give a wallet address. The form asks for "The wallet that will mint on Ethereum. Use one you control, not an exchange address." You type the address in; a new, empty wallet is the safer choice.
Go back to the hub. The whitelist task checks itself and can take up to a day to show the 1.1x multiplier. Do it before 25 November 2026, 21:00 UTC.
Check in each day and submit one X post a week if you want to keep adding points.
what: MMIX has no token yet. Its free points hub and a whitelist for 3,000 free-mint Districts NFTs are open until 26 November. Steps and risks.
behind: No person is named anywhere on the official pages. The operator is "the MMIX Foundation, a private interest foundation registered in the Republic of Panama", with no registry number or address given, and the disclaimers state that "it is not licensed or regulated as a financial services provider in any jurisdiction." We found no investor, funding round or news coverage. The home page shows partner
costs: Everything open today is free. No page we read asks for a deposit, a purchase or a payment. The Districts mint is described as free, but it is on Ethereum, so expect to pay gas when it happens. MMIX has not said how much or when. The real price is your accounts. The program asks for your X account, follows, a like, a reply, a quote post, weekly posts, Discord and Telegram joins and a wallet addres
risks: Age: "You must be at least 18 years old to use the Service." No list of excluded countries is published. The terms shut out people under sanctions and in fully sanctioned countries, and say access can be restricted from any jurisdiction. There is no KYC today, but it may come before any reward: "Some features and programmes require verification, because MMIX is a trusted network." The terms for th

name: Abstract
steps: Open the Abstract Migration Hub and check that the address is exactly migrate.abs.xyz. Connect the wallet that holds your funds on Abstract.

Bridge your assets to another chain. The hub shows the routes it supports, and it also lists the native Abstract bridge , Stargate, Relay and Jumper as alternatives. Crypto Briefing reports a delay of about three hours on the native bridge.

Check what you hold inside apps. The terms say NFTs, staked or locked assets, liquidity positions and funds held through an app may need action outside the hub. Follow that app's own instructions, which the hub links under "All Project Specific Instructions".
Finish early. The terms say each exit has its own deadlines to start and to complete, which can fall before 15 December, and that a submitted transaction isn't necessarily a completed transfer.
Don't send new funds to Abstract.
what: Abstract shuts down on 15 December 2026 and will not launch a token, so its XP earns no airdrop. How to move your funds off the chain before the deadline.
behind: Igloo Inc. raised $11 million in 2024 to build Abstract. Founders Fund led the round, and Fenbushi, 1kx, Everest Ventures Group and Selini also took part, according to The Block. TokenPost reported that Igloo spent tens of millions of dollars on Abstract without finding a sustainable path to growth. The migration terms name Cube, Inc. as the operator of the Migration Hub, separate from the Abstrac
costs: The Migration Hub charges no fee of its own. You pay network fees and whatever the bridge you choose charges. The Abstract Migration Hub on 18 October 2026, with the 15 December shutdown notice, a countdown and the list of alternative bridges. Source: migrate.abs.xyz
risks: Funds left on Abstract after 15 December 2026 become inaccessible. XP has no value. It won't be redeemed, and no token is coming. Assets locked inside apps can be harder to move than tokens in your wallet, and each app sets its own rules. Abstract says its teams will help apps move to other networks. Whether a given app moves, and where, is up to that app.

name: Aura Protocol
steps: Add the LitVM LiteForge testnet to an EVM wallet: chain ID 4441, gas token zkLTC. Take the network address from LitVM's docs . Aura's wallet guide still lists the old Caldera address, "https://liteforge.rpc.caldera.xyz/http", which LitVM has replaced.
Get free test zkLTC from the faucet on the Incentives page. "Distribution happens every six hours per wallet."

Open beta.auralaunch.org/incentives , connect the wallet and link your X account. Warning Many unrelated crypto projects are called Aura. Use only auralaunch.org, beta.auralaunch.org and x.com/auralaunchorg, and never type a seed phrase anywhere.
Do the humanity check. The app says: "Complete the challenge and click on the button below to verify your humanity and ensure eligibility for airdrop rewards." Then claim the daily login bonus.
Make testnet transactions: stake, vote, buy in test sales or deploy a token. Each one is worth 15 points. Do the free social tasks too.

Keep going until you pass 10,000 points with at least one dApp transaction. Aura's own checklist: "Complete your humanity verification and make sure to complete at least one txn. Aim for at least 10k AURA points."
Optional: enter the Token Quest before 30 November 2026 at 14:00 UTC.
what: Aura Protocol sets aside 150M AURA for testnet users. Earn 15 points per transaction and reach 10,000 in the final Bonus Epoch. No claim date yet.
behind: No one is named. No founder, team member, company, address or governing law appears on the site, in the docs or in the terms, which refer only to "the Aura Protocol". Its X account bio says: "Empowering founders with a swift, secure, and community-driven fundraising infrastructure on @LitecoinVM". The account was created on 9 May 2026. The tokenomics set aside 20.2% for investors, but Aura has not
costs: The testnet route is free. Gas is paid in faucet zkLTC, and deploying a token costs test coins only: "we've adjusted the token creation fee to 0.01 zkLTC". The task list also has paid items. Boosters raise your points per transaction and cost real money: "Note: Payments are to be made using ONLY ETH on Arbitrum One Mainnet. Boosters activate immediately after purchase." Reading the booster contrac
risks: No country list. The terms only say "you represent and warrant that you are of legal age and possess the necessary authority to engage with decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols in your jurisdiction". No age number, KYC or VPN rule is published for users. No dates. The Bonus Epoch end, the snapshot, the token launch and the claim all have no date. The terms put the losses on you: "including but n

name: Fables
steps: Accept the Claim Terms once with a signature, then claim your points allocation in a separate transaction before 20 November. You get the option you saved by 19 October; Fables' claim guide of 12 October says: "Your choice is final."

If you held PROLOGUE at the snapshot, approve it and redeem your whole snapshot balance in one transaction on the same card, before 20 November. Confirm within 90 seconds of pressing Redeem, or the card fetches a fresh clearance.

To earn FABLES from now on, provide liquidity at fables.fi/markets and stake an eligible position for emissions. A position that falls out of range earns nothing while it is out. The points docs have the claim schedule.
what: FABLES launched on 20 October 2026. Points ended on 19 October, and points claims and PROLOGUE redemption are open until 20 November. Steps, fees and risks.
behind: The terms now name Fables Labs Limited, a British Virgin Islands company incorporated on 13 October 2026, and say the project administrators stay responsible until the company takes over "through a documented handover". Disputes go to arbitration seated in Zug, Switzerland. Until October the site named Alphix Association, a Swiss association in Zug, as its operator, and the security page says Fabl
costs: Direct deposits and withdrawals carry no Fables fee. Zap deposits, which route through outside markets such as KyberSwap, pay a 0.05% router fee on the routed amount. Fables takes 10% of the swap fees a position earns on most pools, and nothing on ETH/USDG, GLD/USDG and SPY/USDG. Warning The real cost is price risk: a position can end up worth less than the assets you put in, even after fees.
risks: You must be 18 or older. The terms restrict the United States, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria and the Crimea, Donetsk and Luhansk regions. The issuer of the stock tokens also restricts Canada, the United Kingdom and Switzerland. Fables says its interface doesn't block those three. Fables can correct or remove points, and its terms say they are not a promise of any distribution. The PROLOGUE docs s

name: Fhenix
steps: Start from fhenix.io and use only the links on it, including @fhenix on X. The games run on outside hosts such as vercel.app and onrender.com, so open them from Fhenix's own pages.
For credits, open onlyfhens.fhenix.io, connect a wallet and an X account, and do the three required quests. The post and video quests unlock after that.
For shop credits, play one of the listed games with one wallet, then sign in to the shop with that same wallet.
After 21 October, watch @fhenix for the first mainnet apps. Fhenix hasn't published any steps for users yet.
what: Fhenix has no token or airdrop, and says its quest credits buy merch only. Mainnet launches on 21 Oct 2026. What you can do, what is free and the risks.
behind: The site is "published, owned, and operated by FHE Labs Ltd., a company incorporated under the laws of the State of Israel". It names Guy Zyskind as founder and Guy Itzhaki, formerly of Intel, as chief executive. The Block reported in 2023 that "Fhenix has raised $7 million in a seed round led by Multicoin Capital and Collider Ventures." In 2024 Calcalist reported a $15 million Series A led by Hac
costs: Everything here is free to try. Testnet demos need only free test ETH. The shop rules say: "You do not need to pay, deposit, stake, or spend any token or cryptocurrency to participate or to earn Credits." Fhenix Pay, its testnet wallet app, says: "We don't charge fees for using the app." Merch beyond your credits is paid in USDC, plus shipping, and "Prices exclude taxes, customs duties, and import
risks: You must be 18 or older. The terms exclude anyone in or from Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria and Belarus, and anyone on UN, US, EU, UK or Israeli sanctions lists. VPNs are banned: "You may not use a VPN, proxy, false identity, or other technical or deceptive means for the purpose of circumventing geographic, sanctions, eligibility, or access restrictions." name: Inverted Lambda

what: Kalos has no token and no confirmed airdrop. Its NFT marketplace on the Elysium testnet shares 500,000 points a day for trades, mints and posts.
behind: Kalos has not published who runs it. The site names no founder, no team members and no legal entity, and we found no funding round or investors, either from Kalos or in the news. The network it runs on, Elysium, is a testnet operated by Kinetiq, which also runs the faucet and explorer Kalos links to. We found no notice from Kinetiq listing Kalos as a partner; its ecosystem page sits behind a partn
costs: Kalos costs no real money. Every transaction pays testnet gas: "Each one pays a network fee in HYPE, so always keep some HYPE aside." Paid mints carry a Kalos fee, also in test HYPE: "Kalos receives 10% of every paid mint and the creator 90%, paid instantly at mint. Free mints pay no fee." The only real cost is your time. Anyone offering to sell you test HYPE or points is not Kalos.
risks: No reward is promised. Points are a testnet score, the KALOS token exists only on the testnet, and the mainnet whitelist has no stated benefit or date. Kalos has no terms of service and no privacy page that we could find, so there is no published list of excluded countries, no age rule and no KYC policy. The team is anonymous. name: Metric
steps: Check that you're allowed. The terms shut out anyone who is "a citizen of, a resident of, located in, or domiciled in the United States or any of its territories", along with sanctioned countries. You must be 18 or older, and VPNs are banned.
Open app.metric.xyz , connect a self-custodial EVM wallet and pick Ethereum, BNB Chain or Robinhood Chain. The docs remind you: "Keep enough of the network's gas token to pay for gas."
To swap, choose the tokens and the amount. Metric's quote is listed first, marked with a star, above quotes from other routes. Compare them, approve the token if asked and confirm in your wallet.

To take your money out: "Open your position, choose how much liquidity to remove, review the tokens you will receive, then confirm in your wallet." You may get back a different mix of tokens than you put in.
what: Metric, a DEX for tokenized stocks, has no token or airdrop. A points label came and went, and referrals launched on 21 Oct. Steps, fees and risks.
behind: The terms name the company: "Waypoint Technologies S.A., Registration Number 155779918". They are "governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of Panama", and give no address. Metric names no founders. The only team member we found is Christos Gkolias, who calls himself "CTO @metricxyz" on X and wrote on 15 October: "after 3.5 amazing years at Uniswap Labs, I've joined Me
costs: Swapping adds no fee on top: "Traders pay zero fees on Metric." The cost sits inside the quoted price, plus gas. Providing liquidity means depositing your own tokens, and the curator and Metric take their share of the spread before you get yours. The docs say "Metric's default share is 7.5% of the overall spread", but the terms allow far more: "a protocol-level fee of up to forty percent (40%) of
risks: You can lose all of it. The docs say: "Providing liquidity on Metric is high risk. You can lose your entire deposit." And: "Asset price losses can outweigh Edge." Metric's marketing and its own terms don't agree. name: Monetrix
steps: Bridge USDC to HyperEVM and keep a little HYPE for gas.
On the Earn page , approve USDC and mint USDM.
Stake USDM there for sUSDM.
Add liquidity to a Hybra pool on the DeFi page for the higher multipliers.
Connect your wallet on the tasks page and claim completed tasks.
what: Monetrix runs Season 0 points for USDM on HyperEVM, with 10x to 15x boosts on Hybra pools. No token is confirmed yet. How it works, cooldowns and risks.
behind: Monetrix is built by the Hybra team, which runs the Hybra Finance exchange on HyperEVM, according to its docs. Team members are listed by first name or handle only. We found no disclosed funding round or investors. Get the next airdrop first We post new guides, claim openings and deadlines on Telegram and X. Join our Telegram Follow on X
costs: Minting and redeeming are 1:1, gas is paid in HYPE, and the docs don't publish a fee rate. Warning Unstaking sUSDM and redeeming USDM for USDC each have a cooldown, three days when we checked. Requests earn nothing while they wait and can't be cancelled. Selling on a DEX is faster but may fetch less than 1:1. For mxHYPE the docs give one day to unstake and two days to redeem, or an instant exit fo

Monetrix depends on Hyperliquid for execution, margin, oracles and liquidations. mxHYPE and mxBTC aren't stable: their value follows HYPE and Bitcoin. The audits page lists contracts for both but no separate audit of them. A Code4rena audit contest in April

name: Noah AI
steps: Open trynoah.ai and check the address in your browser. Several unrelated products use the Noah name, and noah.ai is not this project's site.
Sign in with a wallet, Google or X. The free plan gives 1 million credits a month and one project.

Open the Noah ID page, connect your X account and try the daily chest. Warning Check what a connection lets Noah do before you approve it. Noah's consent page for connected accounts reads: "I authorise and instruct Noah AI to access and operate my connected account on my behalf".

Build something and post about it if you want credits. Tag @TryNoahAI on X, then submit the link in the app.

name: Note Systems
steps: Add Robinhood Chain Testnet to your wallet. The docs give chain ID 46630, ETH as the currency and https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com as the RPC address.
Get testnet ETH for gas from the Robinhood faucet linked inside the app.
Open note.systems/app and connect a wallet. The docs list MetaMask, Rabby, Coinbase Wallet, Phantom and the Robinhood Wallet browser.

Use the faucet in the app to claim mock USDG and mock stock tokens. It gives 1,000 USDG and 10 shares per address every 24 hours. Warning Everything on the testnet is mock money. Don't send real USDG or real stock tokens, and treat any site asking for them as fake until the note contracts launch on mainnet.
Pick a stock series that is open for deposits, choose a barrier and deposit your mock funds.
Open the community page and sign in with the same wallet to see your points, streak and rank. Signing in is a message signature and costs no gas.
Keep notes alive across observation dates to build a streak, and watch @notesystems for the mainnet terms.
what: Note Systems says testnet points convert into NOTE but has published no terms. How the points work, the free testnet steps and the risks.
behind: Nobody is named. The site, docs and X account give no founder, company or country, and no investor or funding round is listed. The project says it has more than 30 partners and advisors without naming them. Its domain and X account both date from 4 September 2026, four days before the token launched. risks: No ratio, pool size or date has been published for turning points into NOTE. The smart contracts haven't finished an independent audit. Its investor page calls NOTE "a utility token of an unaudited protocol under development". The project's footer states: "Stock Tokens are not available

name: Nullmask
steps: Open app.nullmask.io and connect a self-custody wallet. "You need a self-custody wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby, and some ETH for gas. A wallet controlled by a smart contract cannot hold a private balance."

Sign the message that creates your Nullmask keys ("It is free: no transaction and no gas."), add the Nullmask custom network when asked, and register your account. "Registration is a transaction from your wallet, and you pay its gas."

Withdraw at least $100 to a fresh address you control. Waves and split withdrawals earn more points than Fast, and the 18:00 UTC Big Wave earns the most. "The app does not let you withdraw to the wallet you are connected with, because that would link your deposit and your withdrawal."
If you want holding points, leave some funds in the pool.

Open the Points page and sign to see your total: "Sign once to show this wallet's points. It's free, sends nothing and lasts a day." Link a Solana wallet for the MASK payout. "You can link it any time before the payout. Points are kept without it."

name: Reflect

Connect a Solana wallet. No sign-up or KYC is mentioned for this app.

costs: Points come only from money you deposit, so the airdrop hunt isn't free. name: Tydro

name: UP
steps: Bridge a little ETH to Robinhood Chain for gas and connect a wallet at up33.xyz .
Swap for UP, then lock it for veUP. Locks run from one week to four years. Warning A lock has no early exit. The veUP position can be transferred, but the UP inside stays locked until expiry.
Vote for pools before the 7-day epoch ends. A lock that has never voted earns no fees or incentives.
If you'd rather not lock, provide liquidity and stake the position in a gauge to earn UP emissions.
Check the Rewards page after each epoch flips.
what: UP, a ve(3,3) exchange on Robinhood Chain, pays a 100 million UP community distribution each weekly epoch as locked veUP. Who it pays and the risks.

name: ALPHEA

name: Blackboard

Open blackboard.fi and launch the app. Sign in with Google, Apple or email, or connect a wallet. Transfer funds into the product account you want to trade and follow the prompts to authorize trading. The docs say a browser-held agent signs Hyperliquid trades and that "Setup and wallet actions use separate permissions."
Trade. Your share of each week's trading points follows your share of that week's volume.

name: Doma Protocol
steps: Open app.doma.xyz and sign in. A Google or email login creates a Doma wallet, which Doma describes as gasless. You can connect your own wallet instead.
Fund the wallet with USDC.e on Doma's chain. The Swap page bridges from Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana and other chains, or takes a card payment.

Buy or sell domain tokens . Your points follow the fees you pay. Warning You pay fees to earn points that have no stated payoff. A domain token is a stake in a single domain name, and the app warns that prices can fall and that liquidity varies.
Check the quest board and do the quests that fit your budget. Holding one domain token unlocks the daily check-in.
Track your points, weekly rank and level on the leaderboard .
what: Doma Protocol has no token or airdrop confirmed. How Season 1 leaderboard points and D3 Frontier points are earned, what trading costs and the risks.
behind: D3 Global, Inc. builds Doma, and Fred Hsu is its CEO and co-founder. The protocol's terms are issued by the Doma Foundation, a Cayman Islands foundation company. D3 raised a $5 million seed round led by Shima Capital in September 2023 and a $25 million Series A led by Paradigm, with Coinbase Ventures taking part, in January 2025, according to The Block. Doma charges 0.50% while a token is still on its bonding curve and 0.10% after that, plus the liquidity pool's own fee, commonly 0.05% to 0.30%. With your own wallet you also pay gas in ETH. If your order does complete, you pay your full posted price even when the registry price is lower.

name: Morfi Markets

Open Rewards, connect your X account and work through the tasks.

name: Rome Protocol
steps: Open civitas.mainnet.romeprotocol.xyz/points and paste an EVM or Solana address, or connect a wallet. Up to 20 wallets can be combined.
Practise free on Hadrian, the testnet, with test USDC from Circle's faucet, bridged in. It doesn't add to mainnet Laurels.

Use Portus : "Lend USDC in a Kamino market you choose and withdraw to the same wallet." Warning Portus puts your USDC into a lending market on Solana, where a contract bug or market stress can cost you part of it. Lend only what you can afford to lose.

costs: "Voltrade does not need to custody user trading funds", and most entries cost only a signature, so your real costs are venue fees and market risk. Proof of Trader is free: "Proving a wallet is yours takes one signature, which is not a transaction and costs no gas." PnL challenges on Hyperliquid are different. You buy a USDC ticket, with templates from $10 to $250 and a $1 minimum, and "Every entra
risks: Shown rewards aren't final. The terms let the operator "withhold, delay, reduce, or cancel rewards", and add: "Any displayed ranking, projected payout, estimated reward, or timing is informational only unless expressly confirmed by us in writing." Some prizes depend on trust. Of off-platform payouts, Voltrade's own article says "every property of the other two rails is replaced by trust in the ope

name: ZeruAI
steps: Open app.zaps.markets and paste a wallet address to preview it. You don't need to sign in for this. Warning ZeruAI uses many domains, including zeruai.org, zaps.markets and zaps.market, which makes fake sites easier to pass off. The docs say: "Verify the destination before connecting a wallet."
Sign in with X or a wallet: "You can start with a wallet and add X later." With wallet-only sign-in, that wallet becomes your public identity, so X is the more private choice.
Link your other wallets: "Link up to 10 wallets by signing a message that costs nothing." Never enter a seed phrase.

To enter a campaign, open it in Zaps, press Join or Register, and trade only through the link Zaps gives you. For Aspen you also need an Aspen account and a deposit: "Deposit funds into your Aspen account and run your strategy live."
For zETH, register at zaps.markets/markets and mint a zScore: "You need a minted zScore to win a seat." Then "do the market's activity for real: pay fees, pay interest, supply capital."
After a campaign settles, claim from your Zaps profile: "Your reward is claimed, not sent, and you pay the gas for your own claim."
what: ZeruAI's Zaps app gives free points and runs sponsor trading contests, but no $ZERU airdrop is confirmed. Aspen pays $50,000, and terms can't be read.

The Zaps site says it is "operated by Zeru Technologies Holdings Inc." without giving a country. Official pages don't name investors or amounts, and we could read its X posts only from 5 October to 2 November 2026, so an older post could change the airdrop picture. Get t
costs: "Joining Zaps costs nothing." The free route earns only standing, though. Winning money takes capital: Aspen needs a deposit and $10,000 of volume, and trading losses and fees are yours. A clan member also gives up part of any prize: "If you're in a clan, 5% of your prize goes to your clan leader." The zScore mint is optional for normal use. In February 2026 ZeruAI said "Minting costs just $6.70 o
risks: We couldn't read the terms. The Zeru page showed only "Loading Terms of Service...", and the terms and privacy links in the docs led to a 404 page. So we can't tell you the excluded countries, age limit or VPN rules. Prize pools can shrink: "The pool size is never a guaranteed payout." Your share also falls as others join: "Your share is a fraction, and it shrinks as more people join." The first c

name: DogeOS
steps: Update the MyDoge app on iOS or Android and open The Grand Heist, or open quest.dogeos.com in a browser. Stick to the official app stores and to addresses ending in dogeos.com.
Pick your faction.
For testnet quests, add the DogeOS Chikyu Testnet to your wallet and claim free test DOGE from the faucet . The docs allow 42.069 test DOGE a day.
Do the quests in order and connect the social accounts each one asks for. If a quest doesn't verify, the FAQ says: "Wait 10 minutes, then try verifying again."
Come back for each new chapter, and spend your tickets on the Wheel of Doge . It signs in with your MyDoge wallet, where the tickets are kept.
what: DogeOS says it has no token. Its Grand Heist quests reached Chapter 4 in November 2026 and pay stamps, lootboxes, cosmetics and Wheel of Doge spins.
behind: The website and the quest program are run by Layer 69 Foundation, a foundation organised in Panama. Decrypt names Jordan Jefferson as the founder and chief executive of DogeOS. In May 2025 DogeOS announced a $6.9 million funding round led by Polychain Capital, and its own blog repeats the figure. On 21 October 2026 Dogecoin Labs was formed in partnership with the Dogecoin Foundation. Its release s
costs: Nothing published asks for a payment. Test DOGE is free, and testnet fees are paid in it. The FAQ suggests that some on-chain quests have minimum amounts, and it warns: "Don't repeat a paid transaction just because verification is delayed." You also pay in personal data. The quest program's privacy policy lists your email, wallet address, IP address and device identifiers among what it collects, a
risks: You must be at least 18. The terms bar anyone in "any jurisdiction subject to comprehensive sanctions or restrictions under applicable law" and name no countries. DogeOS can disqualify you "in its sole discretion" for bots, multiple accounts and similar abuse, and the terms let it "cancel or revoke rewards". The rules, the rewards and the whole program can change. The terms say: "These changes may

name: RWAPerp
needs: Requires: Telegram, X post, Email, Discord
steps: Check that you're allowed in. The terms ban residents of the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, China, North Korea, Russia, Ukraine, Cuba, Iran, Venezuela and Syria, and the risk disclosure prohibits using a VPN to get around the block.

Join the RWAPerp waitlist , which is free. Connect your X account, follow @RWAPerp, connect a wallet by signing a message that costs no gas, and do the smaller tasks. You can link up to three wallets.
Wait for access. RWAPerp admits users in batches by XP rank and says it tells you through X, the waitlist page or email. An invite code from someone already inside also works.
Set up a wallet for X Layer. The docs recommend OKX Wallet. In MetaMask, add the network yourself: Network name: X Layer Mainnet
RPC URL: https://rpc.xlayer.tech
Get USDC and a little OKB onto X Layer. The docs point to OKX's bridge . Without OKB you can't send transactions.

Open app.rwaperp.xyz , connect the wallet, accept the terms and sign to create your trading account. Then deposit USDC. Warning This is real money with up to 20x leverage on stocks. The docs say: "You may lose all deposited collateral."
what: RWAPerp has no token and no airdrop announced. Its stock and commodity perps on X Layer are in closed beta. Waitlist steps, costs and the risks.
behind: RWAPerp names no founders and no company. Its terms refer to Cayman Islands law without naming an entity, and the only person identified is a chief operating officer known by an X handle. The domain was registered in October 2025 and the X account in June 2026. A press release that RWAPerp paid to distribute on 3 September 2026 says it raised $2 million at a $50 million valuation from individual b
costs: The waitlist is free. RWAPerp doesn't publish its trading fees: the terms refer to a fee schedule that isn't in the docs. Funding is paid between long and short traders every one, four or eight hours, depending on the market. The exchange's public data listed a 1 USDC withdrawal fee and a 10 USDC minimum order when we checked. Gas on X Layer is paid in OKB. Leaving X Layer through the official bri
risks: Points have no stated payoff, and RWAPerp can change the rules. Wash trading, self-trading and linked accounts may be excluded. No audit report is published. RWAPerp's own risk disclosure calls the protocol "experimental software". The waitlist doesn't guarantee access, and a slot you don't use in time can go to someone else. The waitlist collects your X account, an email address and wallet addres

name: Spicenet

Read the campaign page: the partner app, the chain, the dates (given in Toronto time) and the minimum per transaction. Check the partner app's own terms for blocked countries.

Link your account to the partner app the way the page says. For Satsuma that was: "Open Satsuma, choose Spice Points next to your account, and sign to link your account to your external wallet." For Fun Markets it meant connecting through Privy and funding the account through Spice Flow.

No page explains how those fit together, or which entity would issue SPICE. Matt McConnell is the one person named on the team page. His title varies: "CEO of Spicenet" in the release
costs: The portal account has no stated fee. The campaigns cost real money: every Satsuma and Pare transaction had to be worth at least $5, not counting fees. Partner apps add their own charges. In the Fun Markets campaign, "A 10% protocol fee applies to staking only", and on the portal: "Exiting a hedge incurs a 5% exit fee." Losses there stayed lost: "Neither Fun Markets nor Spicenet will refund losses
risks: Partner apps set their own regions. Fun Markets, the partner in the 30 October campaign, blocks 47 countries and six US states by IP. They include the United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, Singapore, Switzerland, the United Arab Emirates, China, Russia, Turkey, Thailand and Vietnam, plus Arizona, Nevada and Hawaii. name: FLOP
steps: Read the teaser and project intro to pick a role.
If you have suitable hardware, fill in the miner or validator interest form. The miner form includes consumer GPUs with at least 16GB of VRAM.
Follow @flop_labs , which the FLOP homepage names as the place to watch for airdrop eligibility.
When the testnet opens, spend test tokens on inference as an agent or connect your GPU as a miner.
what: Flop Labs plans to give FLOP's genesis supply to testnet miners, validators and agents. What the draft plan says, who can apply now, and the risks.

Each gets 8 FLOP per block, halving with the block reward and ending after year ten. BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes announced in August 2026 that he was coming out of retirement to lead Flop Labs, according to crypto.news. Get the next airdrop first We post new guides, claim ope

The FLOP homepage on 18 October 2026, with the lines "No pre-sale", "No VCs" and "100% fair launch", a prompt to follow @flop_labs for airdrop eligibility and links to apply. Source: flop.finance

name: Panther Protocol
steps: Open pantherdao.app , the app linked from Panther's X profile, and read the legal notice before you tick it.
Connect a wallet and pick the network: Polygon or Base for now.
Complete onboarding and pass KYC with the compliance provider the app sends you to. It checks your ID and runs sanctions screening, and the fee is paid in ZKP.
Activate your Panther account. Keep a little POL or ETH for gas; the first activation is subsidised. Claim the onboarding PRP under Rewards.

Deposit an approved token in the zAssets tab. Holding builds pending PRP; sending, swapping or withdrawing makes it available. Warning You are putting real money into a pool that has been drained before. Deposit only what you can afford to lose, and never enter a seed phrase on any site.
Redeem available PRP for ZKP in the Rewards tab. Check the rate shown before you confirm, because it moves.
what: Panther Protocol pays PRP points for using its KYC privacy pool on Polygon and Base, redeemable for ZKP in the app. No airdrop is announced.
behind: Panther is run by Panther DAO, which votes with ZKP on Snapshot. Its council members mostly post under forum names; the one named person we found is Anish Mohammed, confirmed to the emergency stop committee by PIP-29. Panther Protocol Foundation, a non-profit in Zug, Switzerland, announced the Polygon launch but says: "The Foundation does not operate the protocol, deploy smart contracts, host inte

You also pay gas and relayer fees; only account activation gets a 200 ZKP subsidy. The PRP that matter most come from deposits, so the program is not free in practice. Limits per person per day are set by vote: "a deposit limit of $25,000 per day
risks: The app is closed to US persons and to people in embargoed or sanctioned places. No full country list is published, and the app blocks some regions. "Users must not use a virtual private network, proxy or other means to circumvent applicable access restrictions." name: Variational
steps: Find an access code. Omni is in private beta, and Variational shares codes in its Discord and on X.

Go to omni.variational.io , click Connect Wallet and enter the code. Accept the terms of use, wait while your portfolio is created, then click Authenticate and sign the login message. The signature is free. Warning Withdrawals can only go back to the wallet you signed up with, so sign up with a wallet you plan to keep.
Get USDC onto Arbitrum, bridging it from another chain if you need to, and deposit it with the Deposit button. Omni takes a flat 0.1 USDC from every deposit and withdrawal.
Trade. Points arrive every Friday at 0:00 UTC and cover your activity up to 0:00 UTC the day before.

Variational's docs put people in the US, Canada and Taiwan, US territories and sanctioned regions in that group. Variational can change the points program or any account's total at its discretion. The docs name inorganic behavior and breaches of the terms of use as examples. Points have no fix

name: Decibel
steps: Check that you're eligible (see below). You must be 18, and the terms bar US and Ontario residents.

Open app.decibel.trade from decibel.trade , and connect an EVM, Solana, Sui or Aptos wallet, or sign in with email, Google or Apple. Warning A Telegram group titled as official isn't linked from Decibel's site or docs. Stick to its X account and Discord, and never enter a seed phrase.

If a friend gave you a referral code, add it now. Once you start, it's too late: "an account that has already deposited or traded can no longer bind a code". It's optional, and it gives you no fee discount.
Click Deposit and pick the chain your USDC is on. Decibel bridges it for you.

Trade perps or spot, or put USDC in the DLP vault. Amps accrue daily and show on the points dashboard. Warning Leverage can wipe out your margin. Decibel's scoring favours moderate leverage and longer holds, so there is no reason to max it out for points.

name: Liquid
steps: Create an account at app.liquid.trade . The FAQ says Liquid doesn't require KYC to trade.
Deposit. Crypto deposits are free, and card or bank deposits may carry a fee from the payment provider.
Open a position. The minimum is $10 of collateral. Warning Leverage magnifies losses, and a liquidation can cost more than the points are worth.

Check your points. The docs say they appear on iOS under Profile, Rewards, Points, and on the web in the Points tile of the Referral page. The Leaderboard ranks traders by PnL, volume or trade streak, not by points.
what: Liquid gives traders points that update weekly, with no seasons, but has not announced a token. How the points work, what trades cost and who backs the app.
behind: LiquidX AI, Inc., a Delaware corporation, operates the app. Its founder is Franklyn Wang, a former quantitative researcher at Two Sigma. The Block reported a $7.6 million seed round led by Paradigm in November 2025 and described Liquid as an aggregator of Hyperliquid, Lighter and Ostium. Prediction markets cost 0.90% on both buys and sells, and withdrawing

name: Saturn

Open app.saturn.credit and connect a wallet on Ethereum, BNB Chain or Monad.

Get USDat. The app's M0 route mints it from USDC "without Saturn's direct-mint onboarding or wallet approval" for up to 3 USDC. "Direct minting with Saturn requires identity verification (KYC) and an approved wallet." You can also buy USDat in the Curve or PancakeSwap pools.
Keep the position open. Points build up daily until the season ends.

costs: Orbital Points need money in USDat or sUSDat. There is no free route. The M0 route costs up to 3 USDC to mint, and redeeming costs "the larger of 3 USDC or 0.05% of your USDat input". The sUSDat vault charges "0% to deposit; 0.10% to withdraw" in regular mode and "0.25% to deposit; 0.50% to withdraw" in elevated mode, which applies outside US market hours and at weekends. Withdrawals pay out USDat
risks: The docs say: "Saturn is not available in: the United States, the European Economic Area, and any OFAC-sanctioned jurisdiction." name: Vangrid
steps: Check that you're 18 or older and not in an excluded place (see below).
Open app.vangrid.io and choose Capture Data. If you prefer the Android app, use the Google Play listing linked from vangrid.io.
Connect a wallet: "Your wallet is your sign in."

Get an access code. "You need one to upload captures. You do not need one to browse bounties." The app says codes are shared in Vangrid's Discord. Warning Don't buy or swap codes: "Sharing, selling, or farming codes results in immediate account termination and forfeiture of accumulated PTC."
Allow camera access, plus location if a bounty needs it. Walk slowly around the subject and cover every side.
Open data.vangrid.io , read a bounty and check that its place is legal for you to film. Submit your clip before the deadline.
Complete the payment profile. The board says: "We need your email to contact you, and a CEX account with completed KYC so we can pay rewards."
If your clip is accepted, wait for Vangrid to pay you by hand.
what: No Vangrid airdrop is announced, and its docs say points do not convert into $VAN. USDC bounties pay for phone captures. How it works, who is barred, risks.

risks: Excluded: "The Service is not offered to and may not be used by residents of: Illinois (USA), Texas (USA), Washington (USA), Germany, France, Italy, mainland China, Russia, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Crimea, and any other jurisdiction where the Service would be unlawful or restricted." name: Familiars

Watch @familiarsfamily on X for news about the site and agent wallets. Its last post was on 29 September 2026.
what: Familiars has no airdrop or points, and its site was offline on 18 October 2026. Its AI agents traded real crypto from wallets it held. What to know.

name: Sphinx Protocol
